title: Tartu Art Museum
geometryBasis: The four-corner building at Raekoja plats 18 is individually mapped by address and Wikidata. The shortest edge faces Town Hall Square, with the Kompanii long wall to the west.
sectionBasis: The museum’s written description supplies the 5.8° lean and three storeys. The architectural study anchors the direction of settlement, the rusticated base, the fluted pilasters and frieze, and the bracketed balcony over the square entrance. The mapped hipped roof and municipal height tag guide the section.
limitations: The museum documents a 5.8° lean. The architectural account identifies the Kompanii side as the settled side. The exterior uses a uniform shear toward that side and approximates the variation in settlement.

The mapped footprint is exact to the source vector precision. The façade opening census and positions, eaves, ridge, balcony metalwork and current finishes are estimates based on the written architectural description and building data.
The model covers the museum building itself, excluding the neighboring 1877 bank, cellar interior, and former stables and coach house.
